title: Evaluating the Usage of African-American Vernacular English in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency and contextual usage of seven specific African-American Vernacular English (AAVE) grammatical features in LLM-generated text against native human baseline corpora (CORAAL and TwitterAAE).
Conducting qualitative content analysis to identify stereotypical themes (e.g., poverty, gangs, single-parent homes) and quantitative sentiment analysis using VADER on model-generated AAVE text.
